highlights: Hyperframes is an open-source video rendering framework that lets you create, preview, and render HTML-based video compositions — with first-class support for AI agents.
Option 1: With an AI coding agent (recommended)
This teaches your agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) how to write correct compositions, GSAP timelines, Tailwind v4 browser-runtime styles, and first-party adapter animations.
For Claude Design, open docs/guides/claude-design-hyperframes.md on GitHub and click the download button (↓) to save it, then attach the file to your Claude Design chat.
It produces a valid first draft; refine in any AI coding agent.
For Claude Code, the repo also ships a Claude Code plugin manifest: test it locally with claude --plugin-dir ..
Copy any of these into your agent to get started.
